verdict.rationale: Insomnia has a dedicated Design tab for building/iterating OpenAPI specs with live preview, auto-linting, and code snippet generation, and supports exporting/importing OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 directly, fulfilling the spec-first design and export workflow. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the design/export workflow specifically (community evidence focuses on REST client usage, not spec-design), and no detail on round-trip fidelity or versioning of exported specs.
